# research-brief-schema

> Typed contracts and a dependency-free validator for research briefs and monitored topics, with cross-field rules and JSON Schema 2020-12 export Python package `trysac-research-brief-schema`, import name `research_brief_schema`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
